sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach's strong season—22 points from 10 games and top of the table—has been built on winning form, though they have now suffered defeat in their latest outing. Alsager Town arrive in poor form (bottom half, 4 points from 10 games) and have conceded heavily this season, making this a winnable fixture for the hosts.
divisionWide: The title race centres on Saturday's clash between second-placed Stafford Town and promotion-chasing rivals. Stafford will face Dawley Town away, while other contenders test themselves: AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) host Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points), and Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) visit Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir, and Barnton face Shawbury United—both mid-table affairs. Bottom-club Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a low-table struggle, and Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a fixture between mid-to-lower sides. Crewe play Allscott Heath at home in another basement battle. A midweek Wednesday fixture sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community (19:45 KO).
